state_profile.voting_summary: Georgia votes early: 71% of its 2024 vote came from in-person early voting, with mail a small share (5%) after 2021 law changes tightened absentee rules. Polls close at 7 p.m. Eastern; pre-processed early and mail ballots are released first, then election day precincts report through the night, with most of the state complete by midnight. Early votes ran R+3 and election day R+7, while mail ran D+30, so margins tighten slightly for Democrats late in the evening as mail and provisionals finish.
